tasks.title: Xcode project + WaypointKit package scaffolding, two targets, App Group entitlement
acceptance_criteria: Both targets (Waypoint app, WaypointWidget extension) build empty and run in Simulator
WaypointKit compiles with an @Model type imported into both targets, or the shared-sources fallback is adopted in this same task if it doesn't
App Group entitlement present on both targets with matching group identifier

tasks.title: SwiftData schema: Trip/Day/Stop/Traveler/Expense/ExpenseSplit/PackingItem/PackingTemplate + versioned schema plan
acceptance_criteria: Stop.day is non-optional
Expense/ExpenseSplit store amountCents/shareCents as Int with a computed Decimal accessor
Schema is registered via VersionedSchema/SchemaMigrationPlan, not an unversioned container

tasks.title: ModelConfiguration/ModelContainerFactory with App Group + explicit cloudKitDatabase .none
acceptance_criteria: Single ModelConfiguration used by both app and widget targets
cloudKitDatabase explicitly set to .none, not left unset
groupContainer points at the shared App Group used elsewhere for the debug date hook

tasks.title: Date-range math, day shrink-guard, and the atomic StopReorderService.moveStop
acceptance_criteria: Single-day and same-start-end-day trips compute correct day counts
moveStop reassigns day + reindexes sortIndex on both source and destination in one save, rolling back on throw
DayRangeGuard.affectedStops blocks a shrink that would orphan stops and returns the specific stops

tasks.title: CurrentDateProvider debug hook + ActiveTripResolver
acceptance_criteria: #if DEBUG override reads from the App Group UserDefaults suite and is physically absent from release builds
activeTrip(in:now:) is the only 'is this trip active today' logic in the codebase, used identically by app/widget/Live Activity

tasks.title: Theme.swift full token set
acceptance_criteria: Type scale, 8pt spacing grid, corner radii, and light+dark semantic color pairs all present with no literal font/color/spacing values left for views to invent
Ledger Numeral tabular style defined for all time/money display

tasks.title: Shared components: DemoStampBadge, CategoryPin, EmptyStateCard, TicketStubBackground
acceptance_criteria: One EmptyStateCard implementation reused everywhere an empty state appears
CategoryPin carries an accessibility label naming category + stop name
DemoStampBadge renders identically wherever it's used (app, widget, Live Activity)

tasks.title: DemoSeeder singleton with deliberately unroutable stop
acceptance_criteria: Toggling demo on/off repeatedly never creates a duplicate or touches a real trip
At least one seeded stop uses structurally unroutable (open-ocean) coordinates
Every demo-trip field is marked isDemo == true

tasks.title: TripGateChecker.canCreateTrip (non-demo trip count gate)
acceptance_criteria: existingTripCount passed in explicitly excludes isDemo == true trips
Function is pure and independently unit-testable with isPro hardcoded false

tasks.title: TripSwitcher + trip create/edit with inline shrink-guard and creation gating
acceptance_criteria: Shrinking a date range that would orphan stops blocks inline and lists the affected stops, not a separate error screen
New Trip disabled with upsell copy once non-demo trip count is at the free-tier cap

tasks.title: DayView hub: list + selection state + drag reorder + Move-to + page-flip animation
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one @State selectedStopID drives both list and map, no dual-synced state
Drag gesture and the 'Move to...' context menu both call StopReorderService.moveStop, never a separate implementation
Page-flip animation runs only after the underlying save completes, never optimistically

tasks.title: MapKit pane: MKDirections routing + approximate fallback + two-way pin/list binding
acceptance_criteria: MKDirections failure (e.g. the demo's open-ocean stop) renders a straight-line polyline with a visible 'approximate' indicator, never a silent blank map
Tapping a pin updates the same selectedStopID the list uses, and vice versa

tasks.title: StopReorderService adversarial test suite (10x/20x cross-day regression)
acceptance_criteria: A stop driven across 3+ days in 10+ rapid Move-to calls exists in exactly one day at every intermediate check
Test runs against an in-memory ModelContainer with no UI involvement

tasks.title: SettlementEngine (integer cents) + TravelerDeletionGuard
acceptance_criteria: computeBalances sums to exactly zero across all travelers
minimumTransactions produces the mathematically minimal payment set with remainder cents assigned to the payer
TravelerDeletionGuard blocks deletion while the traveler is a payer or split participant on any expense and returns the specific expenses

tasks.title: SettlementEngine/TravelerDeletionGuard adversarial + stress test suite
acceptance_criteria: 5+ traveler case with mixed split methods and an excluded-payer scenario produces the correct minimal transaction count
A non-100%-summing percentage entry is rejected before it ever reaches SettlementEngine
8-traveler/40-expense stress case completes with correct sum-identity
TravelerDeletionGuard has its own passing/failing case pair

tasks.title: Travelers / expense entry / settle-up UI
acceptance_criteria: Percentage entries not summing to 100% show an inline error stating the actual sum, never auto-rescaled
Settle-up shows the ledger arithmetic proving the totals, not just the final payment list
All money entry/display uses Decimal, never Double

tasks.title: Packing checklist + packed-% + templates UI
acceptance_criteria: Packed-% recomputes live as items are checked
Saving a template and reapplying it to a different trip creates independent PackingItem rows, not shared references

tasks.title: CalendarExportService (full-access EventKit, identifier-based dedup)
acceptance_criteria: Re-exporting the same day updates existing events via stored calendarEventIdentifier rather than creating duplicates
Permission denied, permission restricted, and externally-deleted-event are three distinct returned outcomes, not one generic failure
Model objects are never held across the async EventKit await boundary

tasks.title: Calendar export summary sheet UI
acceptance_criteria: Shows explicit created/updated counts on re-export
Permission-denied and externally-deleted-event states have distinct copy, not a shared generic message

tasks.title: iPad two-pane split view scoped to DayView
acceptance_criteria: NavigationSplitView activates only within DayView, not app-wide
Independent-pane interaction (selecting a stop in one pane updates the other without collapsing to one column) confirmed on at least two iPad sizes and both orientations

tasks.title: Home-screen widget: NextStopWidget + TimelineProvider + deep link
acceptance_criteria: No active trip renders an honest 'no active trip' state, never a stale or fabricated stop
widgetURL opens the app directly to the corresponding trip/day

tasks.title: Live Activity: ActivityAttributes + ActivityConfiguration + LiveActivityController
acceptance_criteria: areActivitiesEnabled is checked before every request, pushType is always nil
Denying the Live Activity permission or running on an unsupported OS/device results in no crash and no Live Activity, observed not just coded
Countdown uses Text(timerInterval:) with update() called only on an actual next-stop change

tasks.title: StoreKit dual-product paywall + restore/lapse handling
acceptance_criteria: Annual subscription and lifetime purchase both unlock identical Pro features via Transaction.currentEntitlements
A lapsed subscription or failed restore leaves all existing trip data intact and only locks new-trip creation past the cap and Pro-only surfaces

tasks.title: Privacy manifest + accessibility + dark-mode verification pass
acceptance_criteria: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares the UserDefaults usage reason
Dynamic Type reflows ticket-stub cards taller without ever clipping a time or money value
Card and pin contrast verified against WCAG in both light and dark

tasks.title: Build-verification: trigger every degradation path and observe the result
acceptance_criteria: Calendar permission actually denied and the resulting UI state observed, not inferred from code
Live Activity actually denied/unsupported and the resulting no-crash/no-activity state observed
MKDirections failure actually observed producing the approximate fallback
iPad independent-pane behavior actually observed on two sizes and both orientations, not assumed from NavigationSplitView usage alone

tasks.title: README: Simulator run instructions + Gaps section
acceptance_criteria: Gaps section explicitly names live traffic/flight data, iCloud sync, and destination-timezone-aware itineraries as out of scope
Step-by-step Xcode/Simulator run instructions, including how to enable the demo trip toggle
